episode.title: This WATER Is NOT Supposed To FLOW UPWARDS?!

synopsis: A man observes water that, when poured, defies gravity and flows upwards, forming impossible rising streams and defying its container.
narration: I tried pouring this, and it just… went up. I swear, it flows against gravity, creating these impossible streams. It's been doing this all morning, and I'm totally baffled by it.

shots.prompt: Close-up of Ihsan's hands, wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt, holding a small, clear glass pitcher. As he tilts it to pour water into a glass on a clean white countertop, the water stream arcs unnaturally upwards and away from the intended vessel, defying gravity. The view stays in one unchanging position and angle for the whole shot.

Ihsan's hands, wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt, try to contain the upward-flowing water in a wider, clear glass bowl on the countertop. Instead of settling, small rivulets of water visibly begin to climb the inner surface of the bowl, dripping upwards along the glass. The frame never moves.

Medium shot of Ihsan's hands, wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt, placed flat above the bowl of water. The water inside forms a clear dome that pushes unnaturally upwards against his palm, slowly rising into the air before falling back down into the bowl with upward-splashing movements. The view stays in one unchanging position and angle for the whole shot.

Close-up of Ihsan's hands, wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt, holding the pitcher again. A thin, steady stream of water gently flows upwards from its spout, creating a small, continuous arc in the air before slowly dissipating, rather than falling. The frame never moves.

music: A sparse, dry, percussive bed of light 'taps' and subtle, upward-sweeping 'whoosh' sounds, with a low, sustained tone that gently rises in pitch. This creates a sense of defying gravity and inverse flow. There are no melody lines, no swells, no ethereal pads, and no vocals. The music opens with sound in its very first second, maintaining a slow, steady pulse and plenty of negative space.
